cover.title: Your room has one more *door.*
cover.guide: It opens onto Tashkent. The key is the QR code beside this booklet.

intro.title: The QR code beside this booklet is your *key.*
intro.text: Scan it and your phone opens MehmonGo: a local team, working with your hotel, that arranges what you need in Tashkent.

promises.noAccount: No app to install. No account to create.
promises.price: The full price is confirmed before you pay.
promises.reply: A real person usually replies within {minutes} minutes, {from}–{to} Tashkent time.

items.title: Scan the code
items.text: Point your phone camera at the code. The page opens in your browser, already set to your hotel and room.

items.title: Choose and send
items.text: Pick a service and fill in a short form: your name and one way to reach you.

items.title: We confirm, you decide
items.text: Our team contacts you with availability, the full price and how to pay. Nothing is charged online.

rides.title: Getting *around.*
rides.restaurantText: Tell us the food, time and group size. We check availability.

entries.name: Русский
entries.title: Что это за QR-код?
entries.before: Отсканируйте код рядом с этой книжкой камерой телефона, и откроется MehmonGo: экскурсии, трансферы, билеты и столики в ресторанах. Без приложения и регистрации. Страница открывается на английском: нажмите
entries.after: вверху и выберите русский. Наша команда свяжется с вами и подтвердит цену до оплаты.

entries.name: Oʻzbekcha
entries.title: Bu QR kod nima?
entries.before: Ushbu kitobcha yonidagi kodni telefon kamerasi bilan skanerlang, MehmonGo ochiladi: sayohatlar, transport, chiptalar va restoranda stol band qilish. Ilova va roʻyxatdan oʻtish shart emas. Sahifa ingliz tilida ochiladi: yuqoridagi
entries.after: belgisini bosib, oʻzbek tilini tanlang. Jamoamiz siz bilan bogʻlanadi va narxni toʻlovdan oldin tasdiqlaydi.

entries.name: 中文
entries.title: 这个二维码是做什么的？
entries.before: 用手机相机扫描本手册旁边的二维码，即可打开 MehmonGo：游览、专车、票务和餐厅订位。无需下载应用，也无需注册。页面默认显示英文，请点击顶部的
entries.after: 选择中文。我们的团队会与您联系，并在付款前确认价格。

back.title: Go on. *Open it.*
back.text: Scan the code beside this booklet and tell us what you need. We will take care of the rest.
back.reception: Code not working? Reception can give you the current one.
back.questions: Questions? WhatsApp {phone}, every day {from}–{to} Tashkent time.
